_comment: Which build lanes serve which hand-written Swift verbs (Phase EV.3). Content verbs declare their own lanes in their manifest; this is the same rule for the legacy ones.
_defaultIsAllow: A verb NOT listed here is unrestricted, which preserves exactly what shipped builds serve today. Default-allow is deliberate for now: flipping to default-deny would change what every shipped user's agent can call, and there is no inventory of what they depend on. The mechanism ships in SHADOW MODE (flag verb_lane_enforcement, default OFF) — every would-be refusal is recorded and printed by diagVerbLanes, so the flip becomes a decision someone makes after reading a report.

_lanes.debug: Developer builds. Always served — a dev build that refused its own verbs would make every QA harness lie about what shipped builds do.

_howToUse: List a verb here only when it should NOT be everywhere. Start with the ones whose blast radius is largest if an agent reaches them unattended.
